entities.name: Magnus
entities.description: Lord Magnus, Dominarian druid and avatar of the woods on southern Argenti, residing in the Sylvan Library.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Place from which Magnus controls plant life and wildlife.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Rebel allied with Magnus against the Empire of Madara.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Magnus allied with Caleria.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Took Magnus from the Sylvan Library and was forced to end the kentsu invasion.

events.summary: Magnus allies with Lady Caleria in her rebellion against the Empire of Madara.
events.quote: Magnus allied with Lady Caleria in her rebellion against the Empire of Madara

events.summary: Ayesha Tanaka takes Magnus from the Sylvan Library; he dies.
events.quote: Ayesha Tanaka took him from the Sylvan Library.

events.summary: The forest, through Magnus, forces Ayesha to help end the kentsu invasion in exchange for her cure.
events.quote: Ayesha was forced to help end the kentsu invasion in exchange for her cure.

events.summary: Magnus retakes his seat in the Sylvan Library and rejoins Caleria to exact reparations.
events.quote: Magnus then joined Caleria once more, this time to exact reparations from Madara.

relations.quote: Magnus allied with Lady Caleria in her rebellion against the Empire of Madara
